The bright yellowish-white mass stretches diagonally, collapses into a compact glow, then blooms into a spiky flare and contracts back toward a small spot over the same streets.

caption:
The video captures a nighttime high-angle city view seen through a soft, wet-looking lens, with a black-and-white checkered building and white rooftop dishes fixed in the foreground and a slender illuminated tower standing on the right horizon. A bright yellowish-white light mass dominates the center above the checkered facade, while out-of-focus orange glows shift at the lower-right edge. The distant city lights remain essentially stationary, and the central glow stays roughly centered while continually changing shape, size, and brightness as it evolves.

The vertical glow stretches diagonally across the center. It collapses into a compact glow, and lengthens into a slanted streak before shrinking again. The same central mass blooms outward into a spiky flare, then contracts back toward a small bright spot. These changes remain over the fixed building and streets. Smears briefly disturb the entire view, while the orange corner glows swell and dim alongside the flare.

The morphing glow continues visibly changing near the center.
